decision_question: Can the locked R3 five-family Surface Source architecture produce a clearly differentiated Automotive hood/cowl, cabin, shoulder/rear-haunch and lower-body hierarchy by revising only Profile / Plan Primary Curve relations while retaining R3.2 termination correction and every existing Machine threshold?

design_intent.profile: lower and calmer hood plateau, delayed but clearer cowl/cabin rise, rearward cabin peak and controlled rear falloff
design_intent.plan: less capsule-like plan with a measurable waist and stronger rear-haunch authority
design_intent.side_lower: rocker/lower-body becomes a visible counter-tension rather than a weak parallel strip
design_intent.semantic_variants: working-fidelity edit amplitudes become perceptually readable while staying inside the unchanged 0.025–0.20 m displacement contract

boundary: R3.3 changes only low-frequency Profile / Plan Primary Curve relations and working-fidelity semantic edit amplitudes. R3 five-family architecture, R3.2 termination geometry/evidence zoning, relationship classes, Machine thresholds, PAP boundary and human-owned Promotion remain locked.
